title: W9 C2 -- Store added fonts in the native app
description: Follow section '### C2 --' of docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/PLAN.md exactly, plus its 'Rules for every worker'. Verify: cargo test fonts passes; cargo check passes with and without native-smoke. No browser tests. No commits, no new packages, never run npm run build or a native screen script. Write the note docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/C2.md.

handoff.text: Rejected for edits outside the registered paths; fonts.rs itself looks right. FINDING 1 (blocking): six files that T265 does not own were rewritten: src-tauri/src/assets.rs, dropped.rs, printing.rs, smoke.rs, store.rs, zotero.rs (642 insertions, 195 deletions, all with mtime 19:15, which matches a cargo fmt run). I checked each against rustfmt of its HEAD version, and all six are formatting only (byte-identical to rustfmt(HEAD)), so nothing functional changed. Still, store.rs is persistence code and this churn hides real diffs from T269 and the final review. FINDING 2: the lib.rs module lines were reordered (smoke, lookup, zotero moved). Keep only the added 'mod fonts;' line plus the two handler-list additions. FIX: (a) for each of the six files, confirm that 'python3 team/team.py owner <path>' prints unowned and that the diff is still formatting only, then restore the HEAD content, e.g. 'git show HEAD:src-tauri/src/store.rs > src-tauri/src/store.rs'. That restores your own reformat and loses nothing; I verified the equivalence at 19:45. (b) In lib.rs, put the mod lines back in their HEAD order with 'mod fonts;' added. (c) Do not run cargo fmt on the crate; if you format, run 'rustfmt src-tauri/src/fonts.rs' only. (d) Rerun cd src-tauri && cargo test fonts, cargo check, cargo check --features native-smoke, and confirm 'git status --short src-tauri' shows only lib.rs and fonts.rs. Minor, optional: remove() writes the index before deleting the file, so a failed delete leaves an orphan file while returning an error. Reviewed (fine): commands, FontMeta camelCase serialisation, id rule, magic, size, style and family checks, index-only lookups (no path built from input), atomic index via store::atomic, root = the same store.root that storage_path reports, tempfile already a dependency, no Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock change, tests cover the plan's step-7 list. I did not rerun cargo in this review.

review.note: Approved (agent-2ff3, W9 reviewer r2). Rework demands met: git status --short src-tauri shows only M lib.rs and ?? fonts.rs; git diff --stat -- src-tauri = lib.rs only (10+/1-), so assets/dropped/printing/smoke/store/zotero.rs are back at HEAD. lib.rs: mod lines in HEAD order with only 'mod fonts;' added; four font_* commands in both handler lists. fonts.rs read in full: plan step 1-7 met (fonts/ under store.root, the same root storage_path reports; .ttf/.otf any case; 1 byte-20 MB; magic 00010000/true/OTTO; family filter 1-64 chars; style whitelist; id rule; duplicate family+style ignoring case -> 'That font is already added'; read/remove look up the index only; index written via store::atomic; tauri.conf.json untouched). Fresh runs: cargo test fonts 3 passed 0 failed; cargo check exit 0; cargo check --features native-smoke exit 0. Minor, not blocking: remove() still writes the index before deleting the file (a failed delete leaves an orphan file); the step-7 'remove then list is empty' case is covered as 'remove one of two, list holds the other'. Native persistence across app restart is NOT checked (T278/T277 hand check).
